prime.options.fsr.quality.tooltip: Controls the internal path-tracing resolution. Higher quality preserves more distant detail; higher performance improves frame rate. Changing this safely rebuilds Prime's render history.
prime.options.lighting.sun_ev.tooltip: Adjusts direct sunlight, the sky, and atmospheric in-scattering in exact 0.25 EV steps. 0 EV preserves Prime's calibrated default; +1 EV doubles radiance.
prime.options.lighting.block_light_ev.to: Adjusts all emissive blocks in exact 0.25 EV steps without changing their light-tree distribution. 0 EV preserves Prime's calibrated default; +1 EV doubles radiance.
prime.options.nrd.debug_view.tooltip: Selects a diagnostic view for NRD validation, reprojection, or motion. Leave this off for normal play.
prime.options.fsr.debug_view.tooltip: Shows FidelityFX's integration overview for motion, protected history, depth, disocclusion, shading change, and reactive detail. Intended for diagnostics, not normal play.
